# Browser test fixtures

- `minimal.pdf` and `minimal-2.pdf` are small Sora Files test documents created for local PDF workflow checks.
- `text-two-page.pdf` is generated by `generate-text-pdf.mjs` with pdf-lib and contains one unique text string per page for extraction tests.
- `blank-page.pdf` is generated by the same script and contains a page with no text objects for no-OCR recovery tests.
- `libheif-example.heic` is the official example image from https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/master/examples and is used to verify real HEIC decoding.
- `sample.jpg` is the public pdf-lib documentation asset from https://pdf-lib.js.org/assets/cat_riding_unicorn.jpg and is used to verify JPG-to-PDF conversion.
- `single-paragraph.docx` is the official Mammoth.js test fixture from https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js/tree/master/test/test-data and is used to verify DOCX parsing.
- `mozilla-cmap-gbkp-euc-h.pdf` is Mozilla PDF.js test fixture `issue3521.pdf` (MD5 `df95d31443e20a38efa29c3a635a045b`) and verifies external packed CMap support.
- `mozilla-password-protected.pdf` is Mozilla PDF.js test fixture `issue21579.pdf` (MD5 `3e067e3d08edfcb84b70b50937cf247f`) and verifies the unsupported-encryption recovery path.
- `mozilla-jpx-smask.pdf` is Mozilla PDF.js test fixture `jpx_smaskindata.pdf` (MD5 `f7a8628b14ca176700247f106c16812a`) and verifies JPEG 2000/WASM page rendering.

These files are development fixtures and are not referenced by the production site.
